rules.requirement: Each night, choose a player & a good character: they are “mad” they are this character tomorrow, or might be executed.

assertingTests.name: the Cerenovus marks the chosen player mad for the next day and night (SNV-CERENOVUS-01)
the Cerenovus needs a good character before it records madness
an expired or removed madness token stops applying
the Storyteller executes a player who failed to be mad
the madness penalty only accepts the legal Storyteller options
ending the day is blocked until active madness has a Storyteller review
a no-penalty madness review can be upgraded to execution later that day
madness stays out of the public and player projections
each overlapping madness condition receives its own review
the Cerenovus has a step on every night, choosing one player and a good character (SNV-CERENOVUS-01)
the Cerenovus makes the chosen player mad about a good character until the next dawn, each night anew (SNV-CERENOVUS-01)
a Cerenovus who names no character makes nobody mad, and one who names an evil character is refused (SNV-CERENOVUS-01)
a poisoned Cerenovus makes nobody mad and gets the shared note, not a failure note (SNV-CERENOVUS-01)
a Cerenovus the Vigormortis killed keeps waking and makes a player mad (SNV-CERENOVUS-01, SNV-VIGORMORTIS-01)
a healthy Cerenovus makes the chosen player mad about the character until the next dawn (SNV-CERENOVUS-01)
a Cerenovus who names no character, or who is drunk or poisoned, makes nobody mad (SNV-CERENOVUS-01)
a madness execution counts as the day's execution and stops the Vortox win (SNV-CERENOVUS-01, SNV-VORTOX-01)
